The modal blind pick is therefore WRONG, i.e. blind performance on this item is at or below chance. I could not break it: B ('Heat rising from the rooms below') is unstated and independently denied by 'Slate heats quickly' plus 'by dawn the whole void has given its heat back'; C ('as wide at dawn as ... in the late afternoon') is denied by the same dawn clause; no sibling question or option discloses the direction (Q3 turns on the flue, Q5 on the whole-text question); no length tell (A 103 / B 104 / C 93 / D 104 chars, key not sole-longest); no lexical-echo tell (key overlap 0.81 sits BELOW distractor C at 0.84, longest passage run 2 words for every option). verified.p4_cast_boxes_deferred_minor: CONFIRMED MINOR and correctly still deferred; it does NOT make the Q3 rationale claim false. The passage reads 'The cast boxes held to three degrees or less, and two were used. Both of those two sat on a chimney breast whose flue still carried warm air up from the block's boiler, and the loggers inside them recorded a swing much like the timber's', so taken as a universal the group claim is false of two of its own twelve members. The Q3 rationale's gloss 'Cast material by itself held three degrees or less' inserts a qualifier the passage does not carry - but it is the intended and only coherent reading (ordinary journalistic generalisation-then-exception, with the exception attributed in the same sentence to the very confound the item tests), so the rationale states a true proposition about the passage while not flagging that it is a reconstruction. Key A survives independently of the group claim: it rests on the explicit clause granting those two boxes 'a swing much like the timber's', not on the 3-degree figure. No distractor is rehabilitated - B and C are both killed by 'cast boxes on two other south-facing walls, with nothing behind them but insulation, stayed empty' (which also shows the two occupied boxes were not the only south-facing cast boxes, since 'other' presupposes the chimney breast wall was south-facing too), and D is killed by 'cast in the same aggregate as the laundry's'. All arithmetic reconciles: 24 boxes on 9 buildings = 12 timber + 12 cast; 9 of 12 timber occupied and 'One of the three timber boxes that stayed empty' agree; timber 11 degrees, cast 3 degrees, the two exceptions 'much like the timber's'. Correctly disclosed by repair_note as still open, and the passage-level fix is correctly priced as a full G-ENG / G-REGISTER / M-BANDS / M-PLAGIARISM re-gate.

findings.status: OPEN by design (procedural symmetry, not repair)
findings.claim: The Q2 cure carries asymmetric evidence - a doubly-corroborated kill-grade flag retired on the strength of a SINGLE post-repair blind leg - and that leg's Q2 classification is more generous than its own calibration on Q3 and Q4 in the same run, because the redesigned A/D pair is a direct contradiction pair and so hands a test-wise solver the same form-only halving that earned Q3 and Q4 a PARTIALLY.
findings.evidence: The flag: verdicts.jsonl carries two independent G-STEM WORLD_KNOWLEDGE majors on q:2 (claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-5). The cure: exactly one post-repair G-STEM record exists for this candidate, verdicts-regate/verdicts-gstem.jsonl, executed_by claude-opus-5/G-STEM, verdict pass / blind_classification NOT_ANSWERABLE; verdicts-regate2/ and verdicts-vfinal/ hold no elf-b14-003 G-STEM records. In that same file the leg flagged q:3 PARTIALLY because 'half the set drops before the passage is opened, with A over B left undecided' and q:4 PARTIALLY because 'The two absolute stances ... drop out against two qualified middles - a form-only elimination of half the set'. Q2's new A and D are mutually exclusive statements of the same proposition ('shaded eaves by day / ridge at night' versus 'warm end by day / cool end after dark'), so the standard test-wise rule that one of two contradictory options is the answer eliminates B and C on form alone - the same half-set narrowing, differently shaped.
findings.why: MINOR, and it does not weaken the cure or the metadata's honesty. Even scored PARTIALLY the item would be flag-not-kill and DEFENDED under the G-STEM calibration, and it would be a BETTER residual than any other on the sheet: within the surviving pair the intuitive blind pick is A, which is wrong, so the narrowing does not raise expected blind score above chance - whereas Q1's and Q5's residual narrowings do point at the key. The metadata is not overstating anything either: passage_blind_record reports the recorded classification and correctly says one leg was run. The recommendation is procedural symmetry, not repair - a second post-repair G-STEM leg on q:2 would put the cure's corroboration level on a par with the flag's, and it is a cheap, additive run that changes no shipping bytes. Noted also, without escalation: for a reader who knows chiropteran maternity-roost behaviour D coincides with the real pattern, so the item is not knowledge-proof against a specialist; that is far outside the HP ELF population's assumed knowledge and is strictly better than the pre-repair state, in which the generic fact alone selected the key.
